Introduction

BLITZERS is a six-member boy group under WUZO Entertainment. The group consists of 6 members: Juhan, Jinhwa, Sya, Chris, Lutan, and Wooju. “BLITZERS” represents “with music and dance moves charging towards the world in a blitz.” They debuted as 7 on May 12, 2021, with their 1st EP Album "CHECK-IN".

On March 28, 2023, WUZO Entertainment announced that Go_U would suspend his activities due to health issues. He later left the group due to health reasons on January 29.
